scorer: WordAdditiveScorer over dependency-free FreqScorer; uniform frozen lexical counts
baseline: unchanged llm_palindrome.search.beam_search with existing initial_state and allow_state APIs
block_arm: typed-two-sided-block-beam-v1; both compatible typed sides including temporary debt growth; separate from reference beam
expansion_policy_difference: Baseline uses original opposite-side indexed expansion. Block v1 explicitly enumerates both sides with residual and typed grammar checks.
action_accounting: Baseline cap counts letter-compatible callback proposals; block cap counts every side/unit attempt, including mismatches. Report these denominators separately, not equal-work claims.

preflight.grammar_source: source-independent finite NP/predicate/complement productions with agreement and article selection; no human meaning certification
preflight.machine_ratings: No verified model ratings included for these pilots

attribution_policy: Any unresolved gap explicitly retained; no affected candidate promoted as original. Source-anchored word-internal fragments are not ordinary complete lexemes.
deadline_policy: Cooperative beam checkpoints plus single-worker POSIX callback deadline; report interruptions and actual elapsed.
